name: std::error_code::assign

declarations.code: void assign(int val, const error_category &cat) noexcept;

intro: Replaces the contents with error code value val and corresponding category cat.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
val

 -

 platform-dependent error code value to assign


 cat

 error category corresponding to val
